timing: Audit design written after model run completed, before this audit opened predictions.npz. This is not experiment preregistration; root already inspected some development results.
primary_statistic: For each market/year/horizon, average squared errors across forecast origins and then across its refit seeds; divide by RW MSE in the same cell/horizon. Equal mean over 4 markets, 2 years, 3 horizons. Classical models have one deterministic prediction.
strong_selection: Lowest recorded past validation loss per market/year, before reading that cell's test predictions. Exact numerical ties follow pool order. Reconstruct RW validation loss and input labels independently.
effect_definition: Positive improvement = macro score(comparator) - macro score(allocation_full), measured in RW-normalized loss units. Also report 1-score(full)/score(comparator) as a descriptive relative reduction in the macro ratio.

bootstrap.primary: Synchronous circular calendar moving blocks within each year: 42 calendar days, sampled on the full calendar year; the same date multiplicities weight every market in that year. Recompute each cell/horizon's numerator and RW denominator in each replicate, then preserve equal cell and horizon weighting.
bootstrap.sensitivity: Same procedure with 84 calendar-day blocks; length is not selected from results.
bootstrap.seed_handling: Before resampling, average squared errors over seeds within every origin/horizon. Never resample seeds as independent observations or expand market sample size.
bootstrap.pairing: The same date weights are used for full, every comparator, and RW denominator. Markets share the same weights within a year; year strata remain separate.
bootstrap.intervals: Percentile 95% marginal CIs, and 98.75% marginal intervals as an approximate Bonferroni simultaneous 95% family for four contrasts. These are development-conditional uncertainty summaries, not multiplicity correction for earlier model searches.
bootstrap.probability: The bootstrap positive-effect fraction is descriptive, not a p-value or a posterior probability.
bootstrap.assumptions: Circular block approximation, chosen calendar block lengths, frozen fitted models and validation-selected families. Does not incorporate retraining, earlier research selection, or prove fresh confirmation.

integrity_checks: Frozen runner and model hashes match protocol and execution-complete record.
All 8 cells and 11 families exist, finite predictions, correct seeds/horizons.
All families use identical observed targets and origins in a cell.
Source CSV hashes match input manifest; dates/price recreate target arrays and train/val/test masks.
All input scale/variance and 14-day energy alignment quantities reproduce independently.
Each stored selection is the minimum permitted validation loss under its recorded trials; refit epoch and seed match.
Check actual selection/refit receipt counts, zero-epoch refits, gradient-positive work, and checkpoint hashes without unpickling checkpoints.
Recomputed primary and ensemble metrics agree with stored summaries.
secondary_reports: native MSE/RMSE/MAE by cell and horizon
